name: team-mods
description: Team catalog of reviewed Claude Code mods, pinned to audited commits. See SECURITY.md and plugins/README.md for sources and patches.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Anthropic sample. Holds risky shell commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, force push) and shows what they would change, with Proceed and Cancel.

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: Anthropic sample. Context window fill as a one-line forecast above the prompt, with a chart of recent turns.

plugins.name: replay-theater
plugins.description: Anthropic sample. /replay steps through the last turn's file edits, one diff at a time.

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: Context window as a stacked bar by category (system, MCP tools, memory, messages) above the prompt. /context-bar toggles it.

plugins.name: mission-control
plugins.description: Team-patched: Haiku edit summaries removed. /mission shows the main agent, subagents and every tool call as a live tree.

plugins.name: change-ledger
plugins.description: Team-patched: git calls time out after 5 s and skip untracked scans. /changes lists files this session edited beside git status.

plugins.name: turn-timeline
plugins.description: /timeline draws the current turn as a timeline: model, tool and idle time, and the slowest steps.

plugins.name: loop-breaker
plugins.description: Refuses a call that failed twice with the same error, and edits that flip a file back and forth. /unstick clears it.

plugins.name: assertion-guardian
plugins.description: Refuses test edits that drop assertions, add skips or change expected values. /allow-test-change allows one.
